types.name: Overdrive
types.description: Adds warmth and grit. Essential for rock and blues.

types.name: Distortion
types.description: Heavier, more aggressive sound. Used in metal and hard rock.

types.name: Fuzz
types.description: Vintage, buzzy tone. Iconic in psychedelic and classic rock.

types.name: Chorus
types.description: Thickens your sound with shimmering modulation.

types.name: Delay
types.description: Echoes your notes for rhythmic or ambient effects.

types.name: Reverb
types.description: Adds space and depth. Simulates rooms and halls.

types.name: Wah
types.description: Expressive filter sweep. Famous in funk and rock.

types.name: Compressor
types.description: Evens out your dynamics for a polished sound.

cards.title: How Effects Work
cards.description: Effects pedals process your guitar signal in various ways - from simple EQ adjustments to complex digital algorithms that completely transform your sound.
